_why: Every edge listed here is used by exactly four triangles: two surfaces that
touch along a line, or face-to-face over an area, because two features in the
generator abut exactly instead of overlapping by a few microns. Each mesh is
still closed, orientable, single-shell and printable - slicers handle this -
but it is not edge-manifold, so it is recorded rather than waved through.
The fix is in the geometry, not the export: nudge the coincident features in
the part s build function in <Body> Print Parts.html so they overlap. Three
of these (camera_hood, 27 edges each) are the same shared part in scout,
wobble and inchworm, and the cradle/bezel family repeats the same small
defect, so a handful of generator edits clears most of the list.
This is an exact allowlist, not a relaxed rule. Validation fails if a file
not listed here is non-manifold, if a count rises, OR if a count falls -
a fixed part must be removed from this file so the list cannot rot.
_rule: path -> exact number of edges used by more than two triangles
